problems.message: proof: the notary refused the upgrade: HTTP 503
the memory limit is 512 MiB and the SDK uses 120 MiB: one proof needs up to 768 MiB beside it

DMarket requires a proof for these deals and this SDK has no prover (prover.enabled is false, or its files were not found): they do not advance until the prover is enabled, or DMarket stops requiring the proof
